# Belly Full

> Belly Full is Kishoreganj's first authentic multicuisine restaurant and cafe, serving Bengali, Indian, and international dishes with table reservations and online ordering.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Restaurant overview, popular dishes, reservations, location, and FAQs.
- [Menu](/menu): Full menu with categories, search, and sorting across all dishes.

## Optional

- [Product details](/product/): Per-dish pages with photos, description, price, and customer reviews.
